newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products-high sulphur fuel bucks dip trend.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products-high sulphur fuel bucks dip trend.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker except for well bid high sulphur fuel.
Gasoline was weaker, pressured by crude, thin demand and plentiful supply. A Eurograde barge was done at $195 fob ARA early in the day, later they were talked at $192/$193.
Naphtha was slightly down on weaker crude.

High sulphur fuel oil prices were firmer on aggressive quotes related bidding and a 75kt Portuguese tender while low sulphur continued to track the weaker tone of crude in thin demand. Steady gas oil premiums failed to stem the tide of sharply lower futures which closed $3.50 down.
